statusHistory.note: London coverage was three places, two of them Shoreditch, and nothing in the queer/nightlife space BACKLOG.md repeatedly flags (Sober Gay London, queer pet-friendly London, Alternative London today). Verified currently open: own site live, listed in Resident Advisor's 2026 London clubs guide. All four sources checked reachable before citing — a UCL News URL surfaced by search turned out to be a genuine 404, so the citation points at the UCL Urban Laboratory project page instead, reached via its canonical URL. Hero is CC BY-SA 2.0 from Wikimedia Commons; it is a 2010 exterior and the licenceNote says so rather than implying it is current.
